description: From the fz-kdt.155 re-refutation (2026-09-02): fn use_and_hand_back(f) do f.(1); f end fails on INTERP ('backend continuation delivery ... backend value was absent and cannot be materialized') while JIT and AOT are correct -- the inverse door split from the usual. Identical at e132fe768, 011897620 and d4734942d (pre-existing, unowned). Family: fz-kdt.99/117 (closure-carrier interp crashes) and fz-kdt.154 (the interp reads dest not return_flow -- possibly the same field-authority question from the other side).

comments.text: RE-TESTED at main a3a9761d1 (2026-09-02): STILL RED, unchanged -- fn use_and_hand_back(f) do f.(1); f end then g.(41): interp 'backend continuation delivery executable=0 entry=1: backend value was absent and cannot be materialized', JIT 42. Reproducer: session scratchpad t160.fz.

title: f.(x); f -- use a closure then hand it back: interp-only failure, JIT/AOT correct
